The turtle has a high-domed, dark brown/black carapace with visible longitudinal ridges (keels). Its head is large with a pointed snout and small lateral eyes. The skin appears rough and grey-brown. The limbs are short and stout, with visible webbing and claws. The plastron (underside) shows hints of yellow/orange coloration at the edges. The background consists of blurred water and sediment.
